correctness.rationale: The compact pair (Sym^3|G|,fat diagonal) computes Borel–Moore homology and is pair-homotopy invariant, reducing to a rose of b petals. The unordered relative CW chain has binom(b+2,3) 3-cells and binom(b+1,2) 2-cells; signed endpoint contributions are zero for odd petal occupancies and +/-2 for occupancy two. Its integral image is exactly the direct sum 2Z over binom(b,2) mixed degree-two generators, and unimodular column elimination yields H_2=Z^b+(Z/2)^binom(b,2), H_3=Z^{b(b^2+5)/6}. For b=0 the space is empty. Two independently derived incidence matrices and finite exact checks b=1..15 corroborate but do not replace the unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete three-particle continuation of the recent two-point integral Borel–Moore theorem for all connected graphs, with a sharp cycle-rank threshold and precisely binom(b,2) integral degree-two order-two classes invisible over Q. The structurally motivated full family classification and its explicit integral diagonal form are more than a table recomputation or ad hoc finite example.
